subject: maths
title: Very small and very large units

lines.say: A prefix goes in front of a unit, like metre, gram, second or byte.
It lets us write tiny or huge sizes without long strings of zeros.
Like money. A thousand dollars can be ten 100 dollar notes. Same amount, different unit.
Bigger unit, smaller number. Smaller unit, bigger number.
Tera, giga, mega, kilo. Then milli, micro, nano.
lines.write: T  G  M  k  |  m  µ  n

lines.say: Mega is a million. Milli is a thousandth. Micro is a millionth.
Micro uses the Greek letter mu. µm is said micrometre.
Each step is 1000 times the next one.
lines.alt: Staircase of prefixes from tera down to nano; down a stair × 1000, up a stair ÷ 1000

lines.say: Tiny Giants May Keep Many Mice Napping.
lines.write: T G M K (base) M M N

lines.say: Going to a smaller unit, down the stairs, multiply by 1000 each step.
Going to a bigger unit, up the stairs, divide by 1000 each step.
3.5 millimetres to micrometres is one step down. Times 1000.

draw.alt: One step down from mm to µm multiplies by 1000

lines.say: Check. Smaller unit, bigger number. Yes.
Pollen is 0.000045 metres. Metres to micrometres is two steps down.

draw.alt: Two steps down: m to mm to µm

lines.say: The same prefixes work for time.
0.25 milliseconds is 250 microseconds, which is 250 thousand nanoseconds.
For storage, the unit is the byte. A gigabyte is 1000 megabytes.
So a 2.4 gigabyte game is 2400 megabytes.
A 1.8 gigabyte file at 12 megabytes per second. Match units first.
1800 divided by 12 is 150 seconds. That's two and a half minutes.
Microscope photos have a scale bar. It shows the real length of a short line.
The cell is 6 centimetres on screen. The 10 micrometre bar is 2.4 centimetres.
lines.alt: Cell 6 cm on screen with a scale bar of 10 µm measuring 2.4 cm

lines.say: 2.5 bars, each 10 micrometres. The cell is 25 micrometres long.
Ask yourself. Is the new unit smaller or bigger?
Only centi uses 100. The others jump by 1000.
Metres to micrometres is two steps. That's times a million.
Small m is milli. Capital M is mega. Very different!
Down the stairs, times 1000. Up the stairs, divide by 1000.
Smaller unit, bigger number.
For speed questions, match the units, then divide.
